  SUBJECT: ECE 2254/ECE_2254 - VLSI DESIGN  
  VLSI DESIGN [ECE 2254]  
  Marks: 50                                                                               Duration: 180 mins.  
  A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  Missing data may be suitably assumed.  
  1A)          Discuss the operation of any two different forms of pull-up for an NMOS inverter  
  circuit. Draw transfer characteristics for these different forms of pull-up. Compare the      (4)  
  relative merits of these different forms of pull-up.  
  
  1B)          With neat diagrams, explain the working of the MOS capacitor. Briefly illustrate the  
  fabrication steps of a MOS Capacitor.                                                         (3)  
  
  1C)          Refer the pass-transistor based logic network given in FIG 1C.  
  (a) Determine the truth table for the circuit and indicate the logic function performed by  
  the topology?  
  (b) Specify the role of PMOS transistor in this circuit?  
  
  
  (3)  
  
  
  2A)          Implement Static CMOS circuit of half Adder with truth table.  
  (4)  
  
  2B)          Implement and explain the working of 2 input NOR using clocked CMOS(C2MOS) and  
  draw the stick diagram.                                                        (3)  
  
  2C)          Explain with diagram, the working of 4X4 OR ROM for the table given and draw Stick            (3)  
  diagram.

  colour code/ shades as per the standard conventions to distinguish different regions/ (4)  
  layers.  
  
  3B)           A semi-conductor industry wants to fabricate a MOS with its substrate as pentavalent  
  impurities and trivalent impurities as source and drain. Explain the steps involved in the (3)  
  fabrication of the mentioned MOS.  
  
  3C)           List the steps involved Fin-FET fabrication process with neat diagrams.  
  (3)  
  
  4A)           Implement an static CMOS circuit of Y=(A+B+C)| and Draw the layout.                           (4)  
  
  4B)           Calculate the total delay in geometrically cascaded CMOS inverters shown in the figure  
  below. Assume f=e=2. 7==3.  
  
  
  (3)  
  
  
  4C)           Derive the scaling factors with respect to MOSFET.  
  i) Gate Area  
  ii) Gate capacitance per unit Area                                                            (3)  
  iii) Gate capacitance  
  
  5A)           Construct a CMOS PLA to implement the following functions  
  $$X = AB′D + A′C′ + BC + C′D′$$  
  $$Y = A′C′ + AC + C′D′                                                                          (4)$$  
  $$Z = CD + A′C′ + AB′D$$

  employed to implement a 2-input logic OR function.                                            (3)
